IF / EVALUATE / ON SIZE ERROR positions: covered by probe E:\COBOL-coord\scratch\op-20261114\read-2002\out\probes-p-18\ct_ctx.cob at --std 2002
cases.reason: The rule's reach is 'anywhere ... an imperative-statement may be used', and in 2002 that set includes CALL format 1 (on-overflow) ON OVERFLOW imperative-statement-1 and the communication RECEIVE (A.2.5) NO DATA and WITH DATA imperative-statements. The 2023 row cannot witness CONTINUE there. Probes at 2002: ct_ovf (CALL "P18NOSUCH" ON OVERFLOW CONTINUE, then the same with DISPLAY "OVF") prints OVF AFTER; ct_recv (RECEIVE CIN MESSAGE INTO MSG NO DATA CONTINUE WITH DATA CONTINUE) compiles and runs (OK); ct_ctx prints OK 1 at both. At 2023 ct_ovf is refused (COBOL0882) and ct_recv is refused (COBOL0902).
cases.widening: 2023 CONTINUE gains the AFTER ... SECONDS phrase.
cases.needs: its own verdict: the compiler's behaviour at --std 2002 for CONTINUE as the CALL ON OVERFLOW imperative and as the communication RECEIVE NO DATA / WITH DATA imperative is to accept and run it (probes ct_ovf.cob, ct_recv.cob)

cases.reason: SR17 rests on what 'an interface specified in the REPOSITORY paragraph' may be and where it may be used, and that changed. 2002 12.2.7.3 GR7 lets interface-name-2 be used throughout the environment division's scope with no exception, and 2002 9.3.13 says naming a parameterized interface in REPOSITORY creates an instance of it. 2023 12.3.8.4 GR7 adds a second sentence: an interface described with USING may be specified ONLY in the REPOSITORY paragraph. So USE AFTER EO PI, with PI a parameterized interface named in REPOSITORY, satisfies 2002 SR17 and no 2002 rule forbids it, while 2023 forbids it. The reader cited p-01 GR-12.2.7.3-9 as proof that the specifier is the same, but the p-01 refuter left that row DOUBTFUL for this same 9.3.13 change. Probe use_eo_param.cob: refused at --std 2002 AND 2023 with COBOL0859, whose text cites §2023:12.3.8.4 GR1/GR7. The compiler's SR17 check applies the 2023-only restriction at 2002. This is probably a defect, unless the 2002 9.3.13 wording is read as not admitting a non-EXPANDS use (the open p-01 question). Sibling: SR16 (class-name-1) uses the same check and the same diagnostic.

cases.reason: The format is identical, but SR1 tests the category of identifier-1, and in 2002 identifier-1 may reference a communication-section item whose category comes only from Annex A. Examples are the implicit CD data-names (A.1.2.3 GR2a SYMBOLIC QUEUE and GR2g SYMBOLIC SOURCE are elementary alphanumeric, so they are legal; GR2h TEXT LENGTH and GR2k MESSAGE COUNT are implicit unsigned integers, so they are illegal) and items of a CD record. cases.reason: Same format apart from ROUNDED becoming rounded-phrase.
